mapping_objects.capability_description: Provider of the Event, indicating the used Operating System
Indicates whether the event came from an archived log file.
Captured call stack or trace information at the time of the event.
Additional client context or metadata included with the event.
Full command-line string used to launch the process (for Process Create events).
Company name embedded in the executable's metadata, if present.
Hostname of the machine on which the event was recorded.
Current sysmon configuration XML text, as loaded when the service started.
Hash value of the loaded configuration file for integrity verification.
Identifier of the consumer (e.g., Windows Event Log) that received the event.
Raw contents or payload associated with the event record.
UTC timestamp when the event was created by the sysmon service.
Current working directory of the process at the time of the event.
Textual description or message associated with the event.
Destination path or resource targeted by the event (e.g., file path, registry key).
Resolved hostname of a remote endpoint (for network events).
IP address of the remote endpoint involved in the event.
Boolean flag indicating if the destination IP is IPv6.
TCP/UDP port number used by the destination (for network events).
Resolved service name for the destination port (e.g., http, dns).
Additional detailed information provided by the event source.
Device identifier or name associated with the event (e.g., storage device).
Numeric identifier of the sysmon event type (e.g., 1 = Process Create, 3 = Network Connection).
Human-readable name corresponding to the EventID (e.g., ProcessCreate, FileCreate).
Namespace or category grouping for the event type.
Sub-type or classification of the main EventID.
Version string from the executable file's metadata, if available.
Name or identifier of any filter applied to include or exclude this event.
Access rights granted in the event (e.g., ReadData, WriteData).
Cryptographic hash of a single file or object.
List of cryptographic hashes (MD5, SHA1, SHA256) for the file or object.
Internal unique identifier assigned by sysmon to each record.
Full path to the executable image involved in the event.
Path of a module or driver image loaded into a process.
Boolean flag indicating if the action was initiated locally or remotely.
Integrity level of the process (e.g., High, Medium, Low).
Boolean indicating whether the target object is an executable file.
GUID representing the logon session for the event's process.
